title: Cross-jurisdiction: UK-compliant biscuit label evaluated against India rules

blocks.text: Ingredients: WHEAT FLOUR (42%), Sugar, Vegetable oil, WHOLE MILK POWDER, WHOLEMEAL WHEAT FLOUR, Raising agents (sodium bicarbonate, malic acid), Salt
Nutrition Information (per 100 g): Energy 480 kcal, Fat 20.0 g of which saturates 9.0 g, Carbohydrate 68.0 g of which sugars 22.0 g, Fibre 3.0 g, Protein 6.0 g, Salt 0.7 g
Made in the UK for Oakfield Bakers Ltd, 22 Mill Lane, Leeds, LS6 3AB, United Kingdom
Store in a cool, dry place. Best enjoyed within 3 days of opening.

notes: Identical label content to UK-001, which is a fully UK-compliant digestive biscuit label. Evaluated here under India's rules with imported=true. Demonstrates that a label built to satisfy one jurisdiction can still fail another: no veg/non-veg symbol, no FSSAI licence, allergens are emphasised in-list per UK style rather than declared in a separate Contains statement per India style, no India-recognised date-of-manufacture-plus-expiry pairing (only a UK-style best before date), and no importer address for the Indian market.
